mentions.name: Everyday Earth
mentions.description: This tool takes video clips from different styles of cameras and turns them into documentary-style wildlife narration. It grew out of a nesting box project built from an old wooden shelf with a camera inside, which was taken over by a screech owl and now captures nighttime backyard wildlife.
